candidate.name: EXISTENTIAL_PREFIX_ACCUMULATION
candidate.state_i: S_i = exists x_1 ... exists x_i . F, represented as the original CNF F plus an existential-prefix list
candidate.transition: Move one currently free variable into the existential prefix without expanding or projecting the matrix.
candidate.rank: rho(S_i)=n-i, the number of not-yet-prefixed variables.

exactness.statement: For every i, S_i is satisfiable iff F is satisfiable.
exactness.reason: Satisfiability already existentially quantifies all free variables semantically; making that existential quantification explicit in the prefix does not change whether some full Boolean assignment satisfies F.

cost_and_state.transition_cost: Polynomial, in fact essentially append/update of prefix metadata.
cost_and_state.live_state: O(|F|+n) throughout if the matrix F is retained unchanged.
cost_and_state.rank_height: n and decreases by exactly one per step.

terminal_trap.terminal_state: S_n = exists x_1 ... exists x_n . F, a closed existential Boolean formula with no free variables.
terminal_trap.key_fact: Determining whether S_n is TRUE is exactly the original SAT decision problem for F.
terminal_trap.consequence: The trajectory has not computed SAT; it has only moved the unresolved existential choices from free-variable syntax into a quantifier prefix.

TRUMP_effect.claim: Any proposed invariant/rank must be coupled to a terminal language whose exact truth/status is independently decidable in polynomial time. A rank is not Legend-grade merely because its syntax reaches zero.
TRUMP_effect.next_target: A concrete projection/normalization state whose terminal condition is polynomially recognizable and whose transition does not merely re-encode unresolved existential choice.
